info.title: Spotpuls Open Electricity Spot, 7-Day Forecast & Smart Automation API
info.summary: Free, CORS-enabled European day-ahead electricity spot prices, 7-day Log-Merit + Hist-GBDT hourly forecasts, and plug-and-play smart-home / EV / IoT / calendar / telemetry feeds across 40 bidding zones.
info.description: Public REST API by Spotpuls (https://spotpuls.app) providing official day-ahead electricity spot prices (Nord Pool, EPEX SPOT, OMIE, GME, TGE, OTE, OKTE, HUPX, OPCOM, IBEX, BSP, CROPEX, HEnEx, SEMOpx) combined with empirically calibrated 7-day (168 h) hourly forecasts (including negative price regimes), conformal probability bands, optimal load-shifting windows, and native output formats for Home Assistant, Shelly Gen2/Gen3, EVCC, Node-RED/Victron, ESPHome/ESP32, Google Sheets, iCalendar (.ics), Prometheus/Grafana, Apple Shortcuts, SVG badges, and iframe widgets.

get.summary: Get hourly day-ahead spot electricity prices, 7-day ML forecast, and smart-control schedules for any European bidding zone

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: European bidding zone code (40 supported zones, plus country aliases SE, NO, DK, DE, UK, IT, IE, EL).

parameters.name: vat
parameters.description: Include national residential electricity VAT (1 = incl. VAT, 0 = VAT 0%).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Output price unit: local currency subunit/kWh, EUR cents/kWh, EUR/kWh, or EUR/MWh.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output integration format: json (full), compact/shelly (<500 B IoT), ha (Home Assistant + ApexCharts), evcc (evcc.io tariff array), victron (Node-RED/VenusOS), csv (Sheets/Excel), ical (.ics calendar), prometheus (OpenMetrics), plain (single value/relay 1|0), badge (SVG), or widget (iframe HTML).

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Duration in hours (1..24) for computing optimal cheapest contiguous window and N cheapest hours within the next 24h.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Optional price trigger threshold in active unit; sets automation.belowThresholdNow.

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: Optional retailer margin add-on in active output unit.

parameters.name: transfer
parameters.description: Optional grid transfer + electricity tax add-on in active output unit.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Field selector when format=plain (spot, total, level, rank, run_now, run_cheap, avoid_peak, below_threshold, min24, max24).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days to return (1..8, default 8).

200.description: Hourly spot price, 7-day regional forecast, and smart-control automation payload.
